author: Fraan_
body:
HI, im _50Cent (not the real one) here are some of my stats :)

  • AGE: 17
  • COUNTRY: Born in Australia, but i lived most of my life in Argentina, so i speack english and spanish
  • TIMEZONE: UTC-3 10 months a year (Argentina), UTC+10 1 month a year (Australia), UTC-5 1 month (Miami)
  • EXPERIENCE: I was in only 1 team in avicus, but i played 5 tournaments in OCN, and i  played for like 10 diferent teams.
  • BOW OR SWORD: both, depend on the map, but i prefer sword
  • LANGUAJES: I speak fluent spanish, and very good english, but not as good as spanish
  • POSITION: In OCN i played at Mid, but in avicus y defend pretty good
  • COMUNICATION/PC: Yes, but in Argentina y don´t have a good pc as in the US, and the mic too. Argentina: 60 fps/ 190 ms, Miami: 200+ FPS, 70 ms, Australia: 200+ FPS, 200 ms
  • SKYPE: francisco.diaz801

I play OCN since 2014, so i have a lot of experience in battle, and in scrims/tournament.
Sorry if i had some mistakes, english is my second languaje :)

Hope that someone is interested in me, thank you for your time :)
